scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I'm checking on the status of my housing loan application. Can you tell me if it has been approved or denied?
dialogue.agent: Your application has been approved. The loan was originated.

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Can you tell me what my interest rate is and the total costs of the loan? Also, has my loan been sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 5.869%. The total costs of the loan are $17,758.29. The loan was sold to Fannie Mae.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have negative amortization features. You were approved for a Conventional:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for clarifying that. I also wanted to ask, what is my debt-to-income ratio, and does that affect my application in any way?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 49%. The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot explain how this ratio may have affected your application.

dialogue.user: Understood. Thank you for the information. I think that covers everything I needed to know. <Satisfied> The agent was clear, polite, and provided all the necessary details about my loan application.
